content.title: 5 Amals for winter
content.subtitle: Take winter as Ganimat!
content.body:
A believer is always striving to become a beloved servant of Allah. One trait of a believer is that they never miss the opportunities granted by Allah. We all seek ways to earn greater rewards with minimal effort.

In today’s post, we will learn about some deeds that can make us dearer to Allah. To help us join the ranks of Allah's beloved servants through specific actions this winter, here are five deeds to focus on:

  1. Providing winter clothes to the needy

  2. Observing voluntary fasts (Short days, less hardship)

  3. Performing Tahajjud prayer (Long nights make Tahajjud easier)

  4. Performing Wudu properly despite the cold

  5. Reflecting on the Hellfire

May Allah grant us all the Tawfiq to perform these deeds. Ameen.
